name: Chow Bright Ventures Holdings Public company limited
summary: Chow Steel Industries Public Company Limited, along with its affiliated entities, is primarily involved in the manufacturing, marketing, and supply of steel billets both within Thailand and across global markets. These billets serve as foundational materials for the creation of various products, including round bars, deformed bars, and wire rods. Beyond its core steel operations, the company has diversified into multiple sectors. It generates and distributes power from sustainable energy sources, operates a logistics division utilizing trailer-trucks, and undertakes the construction and management of power generation facilities. Furthermore, Chow Steel invests in solar energy production and distribution initiatives, provides specialized project and efficiency insurance for renewable energy plants, and offers expert advisory services. Established in 2003, the company's main office is located in Bangkok, Thailand.
